questions.question: Which Gospel opens with the foundational declaration: 'In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God'?
questions.explanation: St. John's prologue presents Christ as the eternal Logos ('Verbum') through whom all creation was made, inspiring the name Verbum Caro.

questions.question: How many canonical books are included in the Catholic Old Testament, including the deuterocanonical books?
questions.explanation: The Catholic Old Testament contains 46 books, preserving the 7 deuterocanonical books (Tobit, Judith, 1 & 2 Maccabees, Wisdom, Sirach, Baruch) from the ancient Septuagint.

questions.question: Which Epistle emphasizes the unity of faith and action with the verse: 'So faith also, if it have not works, is dead in itself'?
questions.citation: James 2:17 (Vulgate: sic et fides, si non habeat opera, mortua est in semetipsa)
questions.explanation: St. James teaches that genuine Christian faith is not merely intellectual assent, but actively lives out charity through righteous works.

questions.question: Who was the devout elder in Jerusalem who took the infant Christ into his arms in the Temple and praised God with the 'Nunc Dimittis'?
questions.explanation: Simeon had been promised by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord's Messiah: 'Now dismiss thy servant, O Lord, according to thy word in peace.'

questions.question: Which prophet spoke the famous oracle: 'Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and his name shall be called Emmanuel'?
questions.explanation: The prophet Isaiah delivered this sign to the House of David, fulfilled in the Virgin Mary and the Incarnation of Jesus Christ.

questions.question: On which holy mountain did Moses receive the Tablets of the Ten Commandments from God?
questions.explanation: God made His covenant with the Israelites and handed down the Decalogue to Moses atop Mount Sinai.

questions.question: Which Psalm begins with the beloved verse: 'The Lord is my shepherd: and nothing shall be wanting to me'?
questions.citation: Psalm 22 in Vulgate / Psalm 23 in Hebrew numbering
questions.explanation: The pastoral Psalm of David expresses complete filial trust in God's providential care and guidance.

questions.question: In which garden did Jesus endure His agony in prayer the night before His crucifixion?
questions.explanation: At Gethsemane on the Mount of Olives, Jesus prayed: 'My Father, if it be possible, let this chalice pass from me. Nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.'

questions.question: On which feast day was the Holy Spirit poured out upon the Apostles in tongues as of fire?
questions.explanation: Fifty days after the Resurrection, on the Jewish feast of Pentecost (Shavuot), the Holy Spirit descended, marking the birth of the Church.

questions.question: Which early Church Father translated the Hebrew and Greek scriptures into Latin, producing the authoritative Latin Vulgate?
questions.citation: Catholic Church History / Council of Trent
questions.explanation: Commissioned by Pope Damasus I in 382 AD, St. Jerome spent decades in Bethlehem translating the Sacred Scriptures into Latin.

questions.question: In the Parable of the Good Samaritan (Luke 10), who was the first person to pass by the wounded traveler without assisting?
questions.explanation: A priest went down the same way and, seeing him, passed by; then a Levite similarly passed by before the Samaritan showed mercy.

questions.question: Which book of Wisdom begins with the famous passage: 'All things have their season, and in their times all things pass under heaven' ('A time to be born, and a time to die')?
questions.explanation: Written by Qoheleth, Ecclesiastes reflects on the seasons of human mortality and the sovereignty of God over time.
